models.name: Kilosort4 predefined universal templates and temporal PCs
models.description: The predefined single-channel temporal basis (`wPCA`, 6 x 61) and universal templates (`wTEMP`, 6 x 61) Kilosort4 uses when `templates_from_data = false` (by default both are learned from the recording).

provenance.name: Kilosort4
provenance.notes: URL from kilosort/utils.py::template_path (MouseLand/Kilosort); file downloaded and hashed 2026-10-05. wPCA is stored in Fortran order. The EMUsort fork downloads the same file from https://www.kilosort.org/downloads/wTEMP.npz.
